ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across the central and lower regions, with high-intensity (white/light-gray) pixels concentrated at the distal tips; approximate ratio is 80:20 dark to light.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Ventral surface is dominated by a contiguous dark gray/black central mass. High-contrast white/light-gray contiguous zones occupy the outer 15% of each lobe's lateral tips. Numerous small, discrete high-intensity focal spots are scattered across the dark central field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression located at the central axis, dividing the lobes with a depth of approximately 18% of the fluke's vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency irregular serrations. The right lobe exhibits more pronounced jagged peaks (amplitude 5-12 pixels) compared to the left lobe, which has more rounded variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve originating from the lower center, sweeping upward and outward to a high-elevation distal tip on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of multiple small, circular white pixel clusters (2-8 pixels in diameter) distributed in the medial dark regions, likely corresponding to barnacle attachment points.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, vertically-oriented light-gray linear pixel disruptions (scratches) are visible on the left lobe's upper region; horizontal rake-like marks are visible on the upper right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized clusters of high-relief, textured pixel anomalies (barnacle colonization) are visible at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly symmetrical placement of light-pigmented patches at the lateral margins of both fluke lobes.
